SELECT source_id, source_name, source_type, source_url, parser_name, parser_config, has_weekend_menu
FROM public.lunch_sources
WHERE enabled AND COALESCE(parser_name, 'manual') <> 'manual'
ORDER BY source_id;

INSERT INTO public.lunch_import_runs
(run_id, started_at, status, source_count, item_count, error_count, meta)
VALUES ($1::jsonb->>'run_id', ($1::jsonb->>'startedAt')::timestamptz, 'running',
($1::jsonb->>'sourceCount')::integer, 0, 0,
jsonb_build_object('phase','writing','menuDate',$1::jsonb->>'menuDate','sources',$1::jsonb->'sources'))
ON CONFLICT (run_id) DO UPDATE SET
status='running', item_count=0, error_count=0, source_count=EXCLUDED.source_count,
meta=EXCLUDED.meta, updated_at=NOW()
RETURNING run_id, status;

-- One atomic statement = one restaurant. Restaurants are managed in the admin (lunch_sources),
-- so this only writes menu items; an unknown source_id fails on the foreign key.
WITH payload AS (SELECT $1::jsonb AS j),
item_payload AS (
 SELECT entry AS j FROM payload
 CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(payload.j->'items') AS rows(entry)
),
-- Dishes from an earlier run of the same day that are no longer on the menu get hidden
-- (items added by hand in the admin have run_id 'admin-…' and stay).
retired AS (
 UPDATE public.lunch_menu_items m SET is_available = FALSE, updated_at = NOW()
 WHERE m.source_id = (SELECT j->>'source_id' FROM payload)
   AND m.menu_date IN (SELECT DISTINCT (j->>'menu_date')::date FROM item_payload)
   AND COALESCE(m.run_id, '') NOT LIKE 'admin-%'
   AND m.is_available
   AND m.item_uid NOT IN (SELECT j->>'item_uid' FROM item_payload)
 RETURNING m.id
)
INSERT INTO public.lunch_menu_items
(item_uid,source_id,source_name,source_type,source_url,menu_date,menu_code,category,title,description,price_eur,currency,allergens,raw_text,parsed_at,run_id,is_available,updated_at)
SELECT j->>'item_uid',j->>'source_id',j->>'source_name',j->>'source_type',j->>'source_url',
(j->>'menu_date')::date,j->>'menu_code',j->>'category',j->>'title',j->>'description',
(j->>'price_eur')::numeric,j->>'currency',j->'allergens',j->>'raw_text',
(j->>'parsed_at')::timestamptz,j->>'run_id',TRUE,NOW()
FROM item_payload
ON CONFLICT(item_uid) DO UPDATE SET
source_id=EXCLUDED.source_id,source_name=EXCLUDED.source_name,source_type=EXCLUDED.source_type,
source_url=EXCLUDED.source_url,menu_date=EXCLUDED.menu_date,menu_code=EXCLUDED.menu_code,
category=EXCLUDED.category,title=EXCLUDED.title,description=EXCLUDED.description,
price_eur=EXCLUDED.price_eur,currency=EXCLUDED.currency,allergens=EXCLUDED.allergens,
raw_text=EXCLUDED.raw_text,parsed_at=EXCLUDED.parsed_at,run_id=EXCLUDED.run_id,is_available=TRUE,updated_at=NOW()
RETURNING TRUE AS db_ok,item_uid,source_id,run_id;

INSERT INTO public.lunch_import_runs
(run_id,started_at,status,source_count,item_count,error_count,meta)
VALUES ($1::jsonb->>'run_id',NOW(),(jsonb_populate_record(NULL::public.lunch_import_runs,$1::jsonb)).status,($1::jsonb->>'source_count')::integer,
($1::jsonb->>'item_count')::integer,($1::jsonb->>'error_count')::integer,$1::jsonb->'meta')
ON CONFLICT(run_id) DO UPDATE SET
status=EXCLUDED.status,source_count=EXCLUDED.source_count,item_count=EXCLUDED.item_count,
error_count=EXCLUDED.error_count,meta=EXCLUDED.meta,updated_at=NOW()
RETURNING run_id,status,item_count,error_count,source_count;

## Import obedového menu (v4)
Reštaurácie sa načítajú z DB (`lunch_sources`, spravuje admin) – už nie sú v tomto workflowe.
Každá ide samostatne cez sub-workflow „parser reštaurácie (v4)“.

Audit, transakcie po reštauráciách a e-maily sú rovnaké ako v3. Zmeny:
- reštauráciu nezakladá ani nezapína n8n (lokalita/zapnutie ostávajú z adminu)
- druhý beh o 11:15 doplní neskoro zverejnené menu; zmiznuté jedlá z rovnakého dňa sa skryjú
- beží denne, víkend preskočí reštaurácie bez víkendového menu
- `MENU_DATE_OVERRIDE=YYYY-MM-DD` v env n8n = test iného dňa
